notes.title: For Colliders & Mouse cursor
notes.notes:
Fixed creature colliders. Fixed the mouse cursor disappearing after the game over animation.

If you find any bugs, please report them.

notes.title: Unlock Gallery When Complete Game
notes.notes:
You can now optionally unlock the gallery once the game is completed.
You no longer need to interact with monsters to access sexual scenes. 
Optionally, you can unlock the gallery when you complete the game.

[b][u]Please let me know if you find any bugs.[/u][/b]

[u]Note: Due to the time-saving feature of Intel CPUs, differences occur in time-based codes.[/u]
